title: ELT Connector Schema Drift
dataSources: Fivetran log-service events and REST API (`connectors`, sync status), Airbyte job logs (`airbyte:job`), Matillion task history, Kafka Connect connector/task status, AWS Glue job runs (CloudWatch), ADF pipeline runs (Azure Monitor).
app: Fivetran / Airbyte / Stitch / Matillion logs and REST APIs via HEC scripted inputs; Kafka Connect JMX/REST; cloud ELT via `Splunk_TA_aws` (Glue) and `Splunk_TA_microsoft-cloudservices` (ADF).
spl:
index=dataops (sourcetype=fivetran:log OR sourcetype=airbyte:job) (event=schema_change OR event=schema_migration)
| stats count as changes, values(change_type) as change_types by connector_name, table_name
| where changes>0
| sort - changes
description: Captures schema-change events emitted by ELT connectors so new, dropped, or retyped source columns are reviewed before they break downstream models.
value: An upstream schema change can silently break transformations or drop data; capturing drift events gives data teams a chance to react first.
implementation: Ingest connector schema-change events; schedule hourly; alert on changes to tables feeding critical models.
visualization: Table of schema changes by connector/table, timeline of drift.
grandmaExplanation: We flag when the shape of an incoming data feed changes, so it can be reviewed before it breaks the reports built on it.
